description: This page allows prospective clients to get in touch with Hydrologic Innovation through a structured inquiry form collecting Name, Email, Phone, and Project Details. A prominent 'Book a Consultation' CTA encourages qualified leads to schedule a call. The page also displays office location, email, and phone details to build trust and accessibility for government and corporate clients.
navigation_note: Accessible from the top navigation bar by clicking 'Contact'. Also reachable from the homepage hero CTA button 'Get Consultation', service detail page CTAs, and the footer 'Contact Us' link.

endpoints.purpose: Submit a consultation inquiry form with name, email, phone, and project details

request_payload_ui_passing.name: From a text input field in the Contact inquiry form with required validation and max 100 chars
request_payload_ui_passing.email: From an email input field in the Contact inquiry form with email regex validation (RFC 5322 pattern) and required validation
request_payload_ui_passing.phone: From a phone input field in the Contact inquiry form with international phone format validation (e.g. +91-XXXXXXXXXX) and required validation
request_payload_ui_passing.project_details: From a textarea field in the Contact inquiry form (multi-line, required, max 2000 chars) describing the client's project scope and needs
